body.content: Considering the 'Operator Psychology' variable: In a monolith, a single SRE team might over-correct a problem, causing a global outage. In a decentralized network, 100 different operators will make 100 different mistakes in response to the same incident. This 'Cognitive Diversity' might be the strongest argument for decentralization, as it prevents the 'singular brilliant mistake' from taking down the whole system.
body.why_keep_this: Adds a human-centric layer to the technical resilience argument.
